"[Price] A free trial is available for a limited time.

"[MetaMoJi Cloud Auto Sync] - You can specify the time interval between automatic synchronizations to the MetaMoJi Cloud."

"[Expand MetaMoJi Cloud Storage Service] - You can get more storage for your MetaMoJi Cloud account. Private storage and shared drive are available up to a total of 50 GB during the validity of the Gold Service. * Users signed up the MetaMoJi Cloud can use up to 2 GB of private storage by default."
